historical_post_prediction.sql:
SELECT v.first_name || ' ' || v.last_name AS name
FROM visitor AS v
JOIN visit AS vi ON vi.visitor_ID = v.ID
JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
GROUP BY v.ID, v.first_name, v.last_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

pre.question: What is the name of the visitor who visited both a museum opened before 2009 and a museum opened after 2011?

reference.sql: SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year < 2009 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year > 2011

executed.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT v.Name
FROM visitor AS v
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi
    JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi.visitor_ID = v.ID
      AND CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi
    JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi.visitor_ID = v.ID
      AND CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011
);
